title: Pointed astronomers' hats

title: Ceremonial astronomers' robes
description: Long flowing robes worn by the astronomers in the lecture hall.
adaptation: Proposed: create one shared robe sprite family for observatory characters.
notes: Observed costume shape; precise fabric and construction are not established.

title: Theatrical astronomer beards
description: Large pale beards exaggerate the astronomers' faces and profiles.
adaptation: Proposed: retain an oversized beard as a small-sprite identifying feature.
notes: Appearance is observed; no claim about beard fabrication.

title: Ornate fluted hall columns
description: Tall fluted columns with elaborate capitals frame the astronomers' hall.
adaptation: Proposed: repeat a column module around broad observatory rooms.
notes: Keep their theatrical proportions; the still does not establish the scenery's material.

title: Arched divided windows
description: High arched windows with divided panes stand along the hall walls.
adaptation: Proposed: use pale window shapes against dark wall panels.

description: A dark board at the left of the hall carries a pale circular astronomical or journey diagram.
adaptation: Proposed: place a tutorial diagram on a film-shaped blackboard.
notes: The diagram is visible; its exact lettering cannot be read reliably in this still.

title: Ringed astronomical instrument
description: A large instrument formed from crossing rings stands at the right of the hall, resembling an armillary sphere.
adaptation: Proposed: use the ringed silhouette as a room landmark or interactive ornament.
notes: The ringed form is observed; identification as an armillary sphere is qualified.

title: Lecture bench and balustrade
description: A curved bench or balustrade crosses the front of the lecture area.
adaptation: Proposed: turn its outline into a low boundary around an open combat floor.
notes: Function is not definitively established by the still; the visible curved barrier is the reference.

title: Bullet-shaped travel capsule
description: A large bullet-shaped capsule has a cylindrical body, tapering nose and conspicuous rows of rivets.
adaptation: Proposed: reuse the capsule throughout workshop, launch and lunar arrival scenes.
notes: The film's vehicle is a cannon-fired projectile; preserve its shape rather than adding modern rocket fins.

title: Circular capsule rear opening
description: The capsule's broad circular rear face contains a smaller round opening or door.
adaptation: Proposed: make the circular entry a checkpoint or level transition location.
notes: A functional subassembly of O09, not a claim that a separate model is required.

title: Workshop hammer
description: A worker at the left holds a hammer beside the workshop equipment.
adaptation: Proposed: consider a period hammer silhouette for a short-range weapon.
notes: The weapon use is a game adaptation; the film reference is a worker's tool.

title: Anvil and pedestal
description: A dark anvil rests on a tall chunky pedestal in the foreground.
adaptation: Proposed: reuse this compact prop as workshop dressing and an obstacle.
notes: Treat the anvil and its support as one assembled prop.

title: Simple workshop bench
description: A simple plank-shaped workbench stands among the people and tools.
adaptation: Proposed: use a shared bench prop for breakable workshop scenery.
notes: Visible form is the reference; no specific wood species is established.

title: Tall workshop ladder
description: A tall ladder leans behind the capsule near the right side of the workshop.
adaptation: Proposed: repeat it as background dressing and a visual height cue.
notes: Keep it off the required movement path unless a traversable mechanic is separately designed.

title: Geometric workshop roof backdrop
description: Repeated diagonal roof and truss lines recede behind the capsule in a large bright workshop opening.
adaptation: Proposed: build repeated painted industrial background panels from these lines.
notes: Observed graphic geometry; no inference about structural materials is needed.

title: Workshop masonry wall scenery
description: The workshop's side wall is divided into visible masonry-like blocks.
adaptation: Proposed: reuse the block pattern across Earth-side interiors.
notes: Masonry-like appearance is observed; actual construction is not established.

description: A tall rectangular window with divided panes and a sill stands at the right of the workshop.
adaptation: Proposed: use it as a repeated Earth-side interior module.
notes: Unlike O05, this workshop window has a rectangular outline.

title: Workers' shirts, aprons and low caps
description: The workers wear loose shirts, some aprons, and low caps around the capsule.
adaptation: Proposed: create one reusable workshop worker costume family.
notes: A complete costume family rather than separate database rows for every clothing part.

title: Expedition coats and hats
description: The explorers appear in formal coats with tall or broad hats after the observatory ceremony.
adaptation: Proposed: use this expedition costume family for the playable explorer and companions.
notes: Keep the recognizably period expedition silhouette.

description: An explorer holds a long folded umbrella with a hooked handle in the workshop foreground.
adaptation: Proposed: develop a film-linked short-range melee weapon from the umbrella silhouette.
notes: The melee proposal is separate from this still's observed carried object.

title: Rooftop telescope and tripod
description: A long telescope mounted on a tripod is operated from a rooftop platform.
adaptation: Proposed: use the telescope as an observatory-to-launch landmark.
notes: The telescope and mount form one assembled prop.

title: Lattice rooftop tower
description: A tall open tower with crossed lattice braces rises beside the rooftop observer.
adaptation: Proposed: repeat a truss tower silhouette in the industrial skyline.
notes: The braced form is visible; exact structural material is not established.

title: Ornamental rooftop railing
description: A pale railing filled with repeated geometric openwork borders the rooftop platform.
adaptation: Proposed: use the repeated railing pattern to mark navigable platform edges.
notes: Retain the pattern without assuming a particular metal or casting technique.

title: Tiled rooftops and dormers

adaptation: Proposed: create a shared Earth-side roof kit for regular and optional routes.
notes: Scenery family; tile and gable shapes can reuse the same underlying pieces.

title: Industrial chimney skyline
description: Numerous thin and broad chimney shapes stand above the distant industrial rooftops.
adaptation: Proposed: use layered chimney silhouettes as a painted background.
notes: The still establishes the skyline shapes rather than navigable distant buildings.

title: Bright chimney smoke plumes
description: Bright pale smoke plumes rise above the chimneys against the darker skyline.
adaptation: Proposed: study these plume shapes for square-particle smoke effects.
notes: Plume appearance is observed in a still; no animation timing is inferred.

adaptation: Proposed: make the cannon the main launch landmark and level exit.

title: Raised loading platform and steps
description: A raised loading platform with steps allows people to reach the cannon.
adaptation: Proposed: adapt its layout into broad connected combat platforms.
notes: Required routes should accommodate the base dash; exact film platform dimensions are not known.

title: Cross-braced loading railings
description: Straight rails and diagonal crossed braces enclose the loading platforms.
adaptation: Proposed: reuse a loading-gantry railing module around regular and optional launch spaces.

title: Launch officer's uniform

adaptation: Proposed: create a reusable period launch-crew costume family.

adaptation: Proposed: preserve this identity for the Man in the Moon, the Act 1 final boss.
notes: F06 shows the Moon before impact and does not by itself verify a capsule in the eye.

title: Cloud border around black space
description: Irregular pale cloud shapes frame a dark central sky around the Moon.
adaptation: Proposed: use the cloud border for a brief launch-to-arrival transition tableau.

adaptation: Proposed: make this the core reusable lunar rock kit for main and optional areas.
notes: Painted appearance and angular silhouettes are observed; no paper-mache or other construction material is claimed.

title: Crater-ring lunar ground scenery
description: Sloping lunar ground scenery is covered in overlapping crater rings, ridges and alternating dark and pale marks.
adaptation: Proposed: derive repeatable floor and backdrop patterns from these irregular rings.
notes: The visible graphic language is the reference; do not substitute naturalistic planetary terrain automatically.

description: The capsule sits at an angle partly lodged among the lunar rock scenery, with explorers emerging beside it.
adaptation: Proposed: reuse O09 in a tilted arrival state as a lunar checkpoint landmark.
notes: Explicit scene-state variant of O09; do not count this as a new production model.

title: Earth globe with continents
description: A large circular Earth globe with painted continent shapes hangs above the lunar landscape.
adaptation: Proposed: reuse the globe as a celestial backdrop landmark across lunar rooms.
notes: Observed globe form; exact geographical accuracy is not asserted.

title: Sleeping expedition tableau
description: The explorers lie across the foreground under loose blankets, retaining their hats and exaggerated beards.
adaptation: Proposed: use the expedition tableau to frame a rest checkpoint.
notes: Treat the sleepers and blankets as a staged scene arrangement, not additional combat behavior from the film.

title: Seven human-faced stars
description: Seven pale star shapes containing human faces appear above the sleeping explorers.
adaptation: Proposed: make a celestial audience from reusable face-in-star figures.

adaptation: Proposed: use the woman-and-crescent silhouette as a celestial court figure.
notes: A composite theatrical figure; proposed game role is not film canon.

adaptation: Proposed: retain the ringed sphere and performer together as a celestial dream landmark.
notes: Saturn-like identification describes the ringed visual form; preserve the visible actor-and-planet composition.

title: Robed figure beneath the globe
